then.say: He's sitting where you found him, but upright now, with his shield across his knees.
I felt it go out. The fire in the Nave. Like a hand letting go of my throat.
The wax is still on me. It's not getting worse. I'll take that. I'll take that and thank the salt and you, in that order.
When they open the lift, I want to be the one who stands at the bottom of it. Somebody should be on guard who knows what he's guarding against.

else.say: Still here. Still dripping. They say the Chandler's dead.
Good. I wanted to be there. I'd only have slowed you down.

then.say: A Warden sits with his back to the shelves, knees drawn up, his spear nowhere. Half of his face has gone to wax.
Don't. Don't come closer, I'm not... I don't bite. Not yet.
Aldous. Brother Aldous, of the Nave Watch. I threw my spear down the Crypt Stair and I've been hiding in here ever since.
You're going down there, aren't you. To the Works. Don't. Whatever they told you is down there, it's worse. I carried people to the carts.
The salt's holding. I can feel my fingers. All ten.
When you go into the Nave, I'll be at your back. I know how he fights. I stood at that altar for eleven years.

else.say: Still warm? Lucky. I can hear it in my ears now. Like a candle being blown on, very gently.

do.say: The Drip. It starts in the fingers, but mine started in my face, where the Nave fire always hit me.
They say Bitter Salt slows it. The Order kept it for the Chandler's own. Rubbed into the skin, it puts the cold back.
If I had some I could fight. I could stand in the Nave with a shield again, instead of shaking in here with the books.

menu.text: Give him the Bitter Salt from your phial. (Your phial heals less; he fights beside you against the Chandler)

then.say: You pour out what the salt left in your phial, a grey crust, and press it into his palm.
He rubs it into his cheek and gasps like a man breaking the surface of cold water.
Cold. It's cold. Oh, that's... that's the first cold thing I've felt in a month.
I owe you a life. I'll pay it where it counts. When you go into the Nave to face him, I'll come. I'll be at your side before he's finished his first prayer.

else.say: Your phial has no Bitter Salt in it to give. It's found in the world, and each one strengthens your phial when you take it.
Don't worry about me. I'll hold. A while.

menu.text: What do you know about the Chandler?

do.say: He prays with his whole arm. The snuffer comes round, then the bell, then the smoke and he's behind you. Never where he was.
And if you ever get him down, it isn't over. He goes to the altar. Whatever gets up off it isn't a priest any more.
Mind the Warden by the desks. He was a friend of mine. He won't know you're not a pilgrim.
